subject: The Deal is now over...
author: ZombieTron
body: Looks like the deal is over as MC:LA has sold out! so well done for getting it in time Gooner!

subject: Sold!
author: Gooner Rhyle
body:
Ordered this last night...hope it's as good as some say. Mixed reviews had me hesitating but you're right...I'll probably get more than £18 back from Game trade-in if I don't like it anyway!

I hear the difficulty is hard to master...which for me is probably going to be a bit of a problem!

subject: Play bargains
author: Xandu
body:
I picked up Saints Row 2, Far Cry 2 and Shaun White Snowboarding all for 17.99 each last Sunday. Compared to prices here in Norway I saved £120 in total!

-- The Creator --
